body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Norcent presented its 27-inch LCD TV ‘VION’ and 42-inch plasma TV during 2007 CES Unveiled.

It is a China-based company that manufactures and sells a variety of CE products under its own brand. It is going to display their product lineup at the trade show such as LCD and plasma TV, digital cameras, LCD monitors, mp3 players, memory products, USB pen-drive and etc. It has been selling its products under its own brand for six-years in North America market.
